description: Manage packages on OpenBSD using the pkg tools.

parameters.name: autoremove
parameters.description: Calls pkg_delete -a to remove automatically installed packages which are no longer needed. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: build
parameters.description: Build the package from source instead of downloading and installing a binary. Requires that the port source tree is already installed. Automatically builds and installs the sqlports package, if it is not already installed. Mutually exclusive with snapshot. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: clean
parameters.description: When updating or removing packages, delete the extra configuration file(s) in the old packages which are annotated with @extra in the packaging-list. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: A name or a list of names of the packages.

parameters.name: ports_dir
parameters.description: When used in combination with the build option, allows overriding the default ports source directory. Default: "/usr/ports"

parameters.name: quick
parameters.description: Replace or delete packages quickly; do not bother with checksums before removing normal files. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: snapshot
parameters.description: Force %c and %m to expand to snapshots, even on a release kernel. Mutually exclusive with build. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: present ensures the package is installed. latest ensures the latest version of the package is installed. absent ensures the specified package is not installed. Choices: "absent" "latest" "present" ← (default) "installed" "removed"

examples:
- name: Make sure nmap is installed
  community.general.openbsd_pkg:
    name: nmap
    state: present

- name: Make sure nmap is the latest version
  community.general.openbsd_pkg:
    name: nmap
    state: latest

- name: Make sure nmap is not installed
  community.general.openbsd_pkg:
    name: nmap
    state: absent

- name: Make sure nmap is installed, build it from source if it is not
  community.general.openbsd_pkg:
    name: nmap
    state: present
    build: true

- name: Specify a pkg flavour with '--'
  community.general.openbsd_pkg:
    name: vim--no_x11
    state: present

- name: Specify the default flavour to avoid ambiguity errors
  community.general.openbsd_pkg:
    name: vim--
    state: present

- name: Specify a package branch (requires at least OpenBSD 6.0)
  community.general.openbsd_pkg:
    name: python%3.5
    state: present

- name: Update all packages on the system
  community.general.openbsd_pkg:
    name: '*'
    state: latest

- name: Purge a package and its configuration files
  community.general.openbsd_pkg:
    name: mpd
    clean: true
    state: absent

- name: Quickly remove a package without checking checksums
  community.general.openbsd_pkg:
    name: qt5
    quick: true
    state: absent

- name: Install packages, remove unused dependencies
  community.general.openbsd_pkg:
    name: ["tree", "mtr"]
    autoremove: true

- name: Remove all unused dependencies
  community.general.openbsd_pkg:
    name: '*'
    autoremove: true
